description.zh: 把一条 SQL 讲清楚：整体意图、逐句子句、隐含假设与坑（NULL / 隐式转换 / 分页 / 时区），最后给可读性改写。
description.en: Explain a query: intent, clause by clause, hidden assumptions and traps (NULLs, implicit casts, paging, time zones), plus a readability rewrite.

placeholder.zh: 例如：只看 JOIN 逻辑 / 只看 NULL 语义
placeholder.en: e.g. only the JOIN logic / only NULL semantics
